scope: Synthetic HTML-only design; no company runtime or Power BI speed assertion
checks: Useful default: Market, Abbott, share and Community ADS share one graph; share uses the right percentage axis.
Spaced channel bands align Community measures and Contracts children; extra measures and five contract members expand without losing selections.
Desktop selector sits on the left below periods and scope; hiding it preserves the data and expands the review.
Ex-factory ADS measure toggles channel and subchannel series together while remembering those choices; IMS references remain explicit.
One click on/off and keyboard Space keep buttons, plotted lines and table rows synchronized without selecting children automatically.
One dual-axis graph preserves units/GBP on the left and share/uplift on the right; ratio-only selection works; summary period choices add columns in bridge row order.
58 reconciliation comparisons: Community split, seven Contracts channels, eleven ADS leaves, net IMS, weighted percentages and FY=YTD+YTG; blanks/zero preserved.
Channel-aligned bands retain parent context; search selects matches only and reveals extra choices; lean lines show full parent and child values, with no bar mode.
Combined, driver and sector scope totals agree; multiple cycles remain separately labelled.
Calendar changes preserve FY/YTD/YTG totals; Monthly follows the visible calendars and leaves summary choices intact.
Shared hover and touch-pinned details cover both axes, with correct percentage and amount formatting.
Responsive/light-dark rendering, empty selections and warm local interactions pass without JavaScript errors or network requests.
388 raw/formatted cells match the preserved R01 design across five scope, cycle, unit and table scenarios.
